dedupe_keys.name: cejst version 1 data pipeline and mapping application

description: This repository preserves the Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool version 1 application developed by the US Digital Service with the Council on Environmental Quality. It publishes the data pipeline, scoring application and interactive mapping client, with Docker and component-specific installation guides. Inputs are the documented environmental and socioeconomic source datasets; outputs are processed community screening measures and maps for identifying overburdened and underserved areas. Coverage is the United States, with source vintages and geographic detail defined by the version 1 data configuration. Source is free under CC0-1.0. A limitation is that the README points to a version 2 successor and this review did not establish current federal programme status or continued availability of every input. The historical pipeline can support equity and exposure analysis in infrastructure simulations. censusdis (platform-censusdis) offers related demographic data preparation. No source datasets, containers or live application were downloaded.
